name: TOB AI Settings
description: Single, global defaults for AI generation — a whitelisted method's own default parameters when a caller doesn't override them. Not a per-request override mechanism.

fields.label: AI Features Enabled
fields.description: Global kill switch for every AI feature app-wide (explanations, Q&A, quizzes, translation — everything that routes through ai/service.py's generate()). Off: every AI call fails immediately with a clear 'AI features are currently turned off' message, for every user, regardless of Blocked Users below.

fields.label: Blocked Users
fields.description: Restrict specific users from AI features without turning the feature off for everyone else — each blocked user's AI calls fail the same way a global disable would, everyone else is unaffected.

fields.label: Default Temperature
fields.description: Kept low by default — Bible explanation/Q&A content should be consistent and grounded, not creative.

fields.label: Default Language
fields.description: Used when a caller specifies no language at all — normally the Language row with Is Default checked, but overridable here independently.

fields.label: Append AI-Generated Disclaimer
fields.description: Whether generated Bible content should carry a footer distinguishing it from Scripture text itself, matching the product's own 'never present speculation as biblical fact' requirement.

fields.label: Translations Require Admin Approval
fields.description: Off (default): a student's own Translate button and the passive per-content overlay both show any AI translation immediately (labeled as AI-generated), matching how this app's other AI content already works — the admin review queue becomes optional curation. On: nothing generated by a student or a bulk job is servable until an admin explicitly Publishes it in that queue.

fields.label: Show Translate Button On Content Screens
fields.description: Master on/off switch for the Translate button and its language sheet across every content screen that has one (Sunday School memory verses, Dictionary, Matthew Henry Commentary, Devotionals, and any future one). Off hides the option app-wide without touching translation_requires_approval or any already-cached TOB Content Translation rows.
